request.style: English, Male baritone solo, warm and reverent, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, soft percussion, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Tamar bore Perez and Zerah
Judah had five sons in all
Hezron and Hamul were his sons
The line begins to stand

[Chorus]
Perez father of Hezron
Hezron father of Ram
Ram father of Amminadab
Amminadab father of Nahshon

[Verse]
Nahshon father of Salmon
Salmon link in the chain
Boaz Obed Jesse
Jesse son of David
The name Shamhuth is hidden
In the scroll of Ruth
From Perez to the king
The bloodline stands

[Chorus]
Perez father of Hezron
Hezron father of Ram
Ram father of Amminadab
Amminadab father of Nahshon

[Bridge]
Luke traces back to Adam
Matthew follows the king
Through the generations passed
The promise holds its ground

[Outro]
Salmon of Nahshon
Nahshon of Amminadab
The line of Judah endures
In the book of life
